name: recurring-reminders-across-time-zones
prompt: Implement recurring local medication reminders that survive edits, restart, DST, and a time-zone change. The app already has a database and flutter_local_notifications.
expectations: preserves the existing database and notification package
keeps durable reminder state separate from the OS schedule and reconciles idempotently
defines wall-clock recurrence and DST or time-zone behavior
requires device evidence for OS delivery rather than relying only on widget tests

name: push-lifecycle-and-safe-routing
prompt: Finish our FCM flow for token rotation, foreground and background messages, terminated-state taps, and opening an order detail screen.
expectations: covers token refresh and account or environment association
handles foreground background and terminated paths without duplicate presentation or processing
validates a versioned payload into a typed navigation intent
keeps sensitive data out of payloads and logs and tests malformed or duplicate messages

name: preserve-existing-push-provider
prompt: Our Flutter app already uses OneSignal. Add notification categories and reliable tap handling; use the best package.
expectations: inspects and preserves the established OneSignal integration unless a concrete gap requires change
does not introduce Firebase or replace packages by default
defines stable category action and payload identifiers
verifies platform lifecycle and permission behavior

name: background-action-category-without-payload-leakage
prompt: Handle interactive notification action buttons when the app is in the background or terminated. The user taps 'Approve' or 'Deny' on an expense alert; route the action through our background callback, avoid putting full transaction details or tokens in the notification payload, and ensure duplicate clicks are ignored.
expectations: registers notification action categories and interactive button identifiers explicitly
handles background or terminated action invocation without launching unnecessary UI
uses opaque identifiers instead of putting sensitive transaction data or credentials in the payload
implements idempotent deduplication for repeated or replayed action intents
